# Migrations that predate the `-- @asserts` rule.
#
# FROZEN. Nothing may be added to this list. A new migration without an
# @asserts claim fails `npm run check:migration-assertions`, and adding the file
# here to make the guard pass is the failure the guard exists to prevent.
#
# These 211 files are exempt because requiring 211 retrofits before the rule can
# start is how a rule never starts — not because they are correct. The intent is
# that a file is removed from this list, with a claim added, the next time
# anyone touches it. The list therefore only ever shrinks.
#
# A line naming a file that no longer exists is a hard failure too: otherwise a
# migration deleted and recreated under the same name keeps its exemption.
